survey: A cowboy hat seen in three-quarter view from above and in front, floating against a blue sunburst background (a plain icon, so floating is fine). Parts: (1) A tall leather crown with a pinched crease on top. It rises from the brim with a clean joint. (2) A red fabric hatband that wraps the base of the crown. It follows the crown's curve and closes all the way round. (3) A wide brim around the crown, with a cream rolled edge binding the whole rim. The front of the brim faces the camera and dips. The left side curls up in a broad, rounded roll. The right side sweeps out and up into a long, narrow, pointed tip. The crown, band and binding are built correctly. Only the brim's outline is in question.

errors.where: Brim, right side compared with left side
errors.what: The two sides of the brim don't match. The left side is a wide, rounded upturned curl. The right side thins into a long, sharp, wing-like point. A real cowboy hat brim is an oval with matching curls on both sides, and the camera angle doesn't explain a pointed tip. The brim reads as lopsided and bent out of shape.

fix: Cowboy hat with a symmetrical oval brim: the left and right sides curl up equally into matching rounded rolls, with no pointed tip on either side. Keep the cream rolled edge evenly round the whole rim, and keep the crown centred on the brim.
